description: This file defines a Java interface for generic data access operations for entities managed by JPA. It declares methods for CRUD operations, counting, listing, and retrieving entities based on fields, as well as for managing the persistence context.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityDao
classes.description: A generic DAO interface for managing entities with basic CRUD operations, counting, and querying by fields.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieve an entity by class type and identifier.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refresh an entity's state from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all entities.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flush persistence context changes to the database.

methods.name: countByField
methods.description: Count entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: List entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieve a single entity based on a field value.

methods.name: list
methods.description: List entities with filtering, pagination, and ordering options.
